title.en: The One Where They Decorate Together

description.es: Tras contarle la verdad a Damián, Marta le pregunta sobre la decisión de vender Mafinca. Damián concluye que no se puede vender y que lo mejor es dejarla abandonada. Marta transmite la noticia a Fina y eso la tranquiliza. Luego, ambas deciden dejar atrás sus diferencias respecto al piso que Fina quiere alquilar. Fina invita a Marta a visitar una de las opciones y le asegura que quiere que el nuevo piso sea del gusto de las dos.
description.en: After telling Damián the truth, Marta asks him about the decision to sell Mafinca. Damián concludes that it cannot be sold and that the best thing is to leave it abandoned. Marta passes the news on to Fina, and it puts her at ease. Then the two decide to put aside their differences about the apartment Fina wants to rent. Fina invites Marta to come see one of the options and assures her that she wants the new apartment to be to both their liking.
